parsed.answer: This request (a start/end time window and weekdays for Awake) has been reported many times and is tracked in PowerToys#24846 (Keep Awake on a Schedule), where other duplicates were closed. Scheduling is not available in Awake yet. Please add a thumbs-up and any extra details to #24846. A scheduled 'daily window' mode has been proposed there, but the first version would not include weekday filters. Until it ships, you can use these workarounds from the tickets: (1) start Awake from the command line with an expiry, e.g. PowerToys.Awake.exe --expire-at=17:30:00 --display-on=false, and automate it with a Windows Task Scheduler task (for example, one that triggers on resume from sleep and runs a PowerShell script that stops any running Awake process and relaunches it with the end-of-day time); or (2) set an expiry in Awake each day so it turns off at the end of your working hours. One ticket also mentions the third-party Caffeine tool as an alternative.
